🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — September 16, 2026

Sun, in Virgo, holds a sextile to Mars, in its fall in Cancer. Nothing in common except the angle they hold: the worth of a thing and the account of it briefly coincide.

Easier — Reviewing, sorting, naming what a thing is worth to you.
Harder — Mistaking an easy day for a free one.
Backdrop — Jupiter and Saturn hold a month-long trine underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars governs you, unsupported in Cancer. Across from you in Libra, Mercury holds the other half of the account. Cardinal fire meets a bill. Two weeks in, and the shape of it is no longer a surprise.

♉ TAURUS
Venus rules you, exiled in Scorpio. From Virgo, Sun concedes the point early. Earth that holds on, holding without strain. Four weeks ago Venus was still in Libra: the ground has moved.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you from Libra, untitled. From Virgo, Sun cuts across you: the sum arrives before the appetite. Air bends, and each bend is invoiced. The Leo chapter closed four weeks ago.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, falls in Scorpio and defends what needs no defending. Sun in Virgo opens a gap you have to step into. Cardinal water opens the account without argument. Venus let go of it a week ago.

♌ LEO
Sun, your ruler, crosses Virgo untitled. From Scorpio, Moon cuts across the appetite. Fixed fire: the grip is the expense. It has stood two weeks; by now the cost is known.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, is a stranger in Libra: neither strong nor weak. Mars in Cancer makes room for you, and then waits. Earth that changes shape, and the shape fits. The trine of two weeks ago is off it now.

♎ LIBRA
Venus rules you from Scorpio, where none of its habits work. Mars squares you from Cancer, and the cost objects. Air opens the file, and the file has a price. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars rules you, fallen in Cancer. From Virgo, Sun offers an angle — offered, not delivered. Fixed water: nothing needs letting go of today. The hold Saturn had a week ago is not there any more.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. From Virgo, Sun sets a figure against the wanting. Fire that changes shape, charged for each shape. After four weeks of the same angle, the terms are familiar.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. Sun in Virgo trines you: agreement arrives before the argument. Earth that starts things, started cheaply. The square to Mars that held a week ago has let go.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn rules you from Aries, without leverage of its own. Mercury trines you from Libra, meeting no resistance. Air keeps what it has, cheaply. A week ago this angle was not there. It is now.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter rules you and passes through Leo as a guest. From Cancer, Mars concedes the point early. Mutable water: two answers, neither expensive. Two weeks ago Jupiter was still held by Moon; that is finished.
